question: The ‘Kalidas Samman’ is awarded by the government of which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Kalidas Samman' is given by **Madhya Pradesh** government.
 
• It is a prestigious award** presented annually** by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The award is named after Kalidasa, a** writer of ancient history.**
 
• **Dharwad: Renowned **Hindustani classical vocalist **Pt M Venkateshkumar** of Dharwad was recently conferred the prestigious** Kalidas Samman for his outstanding contribution in the field of classical music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Kalidas Samman was established in the year 1980-81.
 
• In this award,** Rs. 2,00,000** and a** citation are presented in the fields of classical music**, classical dance, theatre, and visual art.
 
• First recipients: **Semmangudi Srinivasa Iyer and Mallikarjun Mansur.**
